description: Recommend AI tools for a job a leader needs done (e.g. 'run better 1:1s', 'write a board update', 'research a competitor', 'grant writing'), using Coghelm's curated job guides and directory. Optional constraints: budget ('free' keeps only tools with a known free plan; 'low' ranks free plans first) and team size (small teams rank enterprise tools last). Returns ranked tools with reasons, pricing notes, and Coghelm links.

job.description: The job to be done, in plain words, or a job guide slug from list_jobs

team_size.description: Number of people who would use the tool

name: recommend_tools
title: Recommend AI tools for a leadership job
